title: A Summer in Portugal
text:
Last summer, Lucas went to Portugal with his family. They flew to Lisbon and stayed in a small hotel near the old city. Every morning, they walked to a bakery and ate fresh bread. The weather was warm and sunny.

On the third day, they took a train to Sintra. The town was beautiful, with colourful houses and green hills. Lucas took many photos, but he forgot his camera at the station. A kind woman found it and gave it back to him.

paragraph_translations: No verão passado, Lucas foi a Portugal com a família. Eles voaram para Lisboa e ficaram em um pequeno hotel perto da cidade antiga. Todas as manhãs, caminhavam até uma padaria e comiam pão fresco. O tempo estava quente e ensolarado.

No terceiro dia, pegaram um trem para Sintra. A cidade era bonita, com casas coloridas e colinas verdes. Lucas tirou muitas fotos, mas esqueceu a câmera na estação. Uma mulher gentil a encontrou e a devolveu para ele.
